entities.summary: Chhim Sithar is a Cambodian trade union leader and the current president of the Labor Rights Supported Union (LRSU) of Khmer Employees of NagaWorld. She served a two-year sentence for incitement in connection to a labour strike she led at NagaWorld in 2021 and 2022.
